stem:
Meera's grandmother plants a small piece of ginger with an eye into the soil of their garden in Nagpur. After some weeks, a new ginger plant grows from this piece.

Which statement best describes how the new ginger plant was produced?

options.text: By seeds formed after the mixing of instructions from two parent plants
By vegetative propagation, because a new plant grew from a part of one parent plant
By two parent plants exchanging pollen and producing fruit
By a seedling sprouting from a seed buried in the soil

teacher.key_rationale: The new ginger plant grew from a stem piece (an eye) of a single parent plant, so no fusion of instructions from two parents occurred; this is vegetative propagation, a form of asexual reproduction. Options A, C, and D all require seeds or two parents, which contradicts the situation described.
